dogecoin.text:
The Problem

Crypto keeps recycling the same story.

By the time the masses hear about a meme coin, the insiders have already dumped.
By the time the thread hits your feed, the dev wallet has already vanished.
By the time you find the next $DOGE or $PEPE — it’s already too late.

They told you to buy $DOGE at the top.
They told you to ape into $PEPE when the insiders were already out.
They told you to chase the next 100x, but never let you be early.

But what if this time, you are the early one?

Before the airdrop.
Before the flood of Kraken users.
